project.goal: A handcrafted dark evergreen tabletop speaker with true interwoven threads, warm copper anodized bezel, machined knob, enamel cabinet and tiny amber status lens. A terracotta architectural podium and black-green set create warm/cool separation. Precise rim highlights and readable woven detail. Six-second restrained orbit and dolly with a real dial motion.
project.title: Nocturne · 织声
